The first release of Malgel, a fast, native Markdown editor and previewer written in Rust. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## Highlights

- **Editor and live preview side by side**, scrolling together in both directions, or either one on its own.
- **GitHub-flavored preview:** tables, task lists, syntax-highlighted code, front matter, images and GitHub alerts.
- **LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams**, typeset and drawn offline.
- **Export as HTML, PDF and Word**, plus copy as rich text for pasting into email and documents.
- **Writing help:** lists and tables that continue and tidy themselves, smart paste for links and images, formatting shortcuts, and spell checking.
- **Optional workspace features:** tabs, a file sidebar, a heading outline and focus mode, all off until you turn them on in Settings.
- **Nothing lost:** unsaved changes survive a crash, your last session reopens, and files changed on disk are noticed.
- **Themes and zoom:** light, dark or follow the system, with a choice of bundled themes.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Malgel-0.1.0-macos-universal.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.0-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed and notarized. The Windows files aren't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: choose **More info → Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.

To open Markdown files in Malgel by double-clicking them, use **Settings → Default app for Markdown**.
